test_objective: Check that you can query context source registrations. If present, the geoquery is matched against the GeoProperty programmatic parameter identified in the geoquery

test_cases.name: 037_07_01 Near Point
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query context source registrations. If present, the geoquery is matched against the GeoProperty programmatic parameter identified in the geoquery
test_cases.template: Query Context Source Registration Matching Geoquery
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Temporal Representation of Entity and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: type set to 'Building' and
    Query Parameter: georel set to '${georel}' and
    Query Parameter: geometry set to '${geometry}' and
    Query Parameter: coordinates set to '${coordinates}' and
    Query Parameter: geoproperty set to '${geoproperty}'
}
